source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「飛行機」(1)機体の特徴

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 飛行機型には安全に飛行できる最低速度があり、それ未満の低速飛行はできない。
evidence.tested_misconception: 固定翼でも推力を下げれば回転翼機のように極低速・停止飛行できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: aircraft type -> minimum-speed constraint -> reject zero-speed assumption

collision.note: LOW。Q060は飛行機の速度・効率比較、Q067は迎角過大による失速であり、最低速度というoperation envelope自体は別命題。

independent_review.rationale: 4.1 states fixed-wing aircraft generally have a safe minimum speed below which low-speed flight is not possible; distinct from Q067's excessive-angle-of-attack stall mechanism.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
